checks.check: the parameters of the manifest are those of the code
standard time series v1 is the one the labels were built from
segments.csv is the file of the manifest
the segment dictionary names every column of segments.csv
segment ids are unique and numbered 0.. within each machine
every segment has a class, an edge on each side and a status
class follows from duration and activity
censored means the edge is neither a state change nor a pause
phase status: ok only for long segments, and then with a steady start and end
the inactive stretches at the start and end fit into the segment, and a segment without an active row is inactive throughout
stalled follows from the median advance speed
